enumeration_note: One VWAP-confluence S/R-retest skeleton taught throughout; long and short are directional applications of the same trend-aligned logic (not opposition), and immediate-limit vs candlestick-confirmation entry plus session/weekly/monthly anchor periods are compatible configuration variants.

coaching_notes: "I highly suggest everyone gives this a go for themselves" (experiment with anchor periods)
"if you're feeling Savvy you can combine multiple levels of vwap ... make sure to also change the size or color to be able to tell which one is which"
"I have just one more example for you so you can really digest this information and put it to practice in your trading"
element_inventory: PRECONDITION (trend gate): price above VWAP = market bullish, take longs only; price below VWAP = market bearish, take shorts only
Use only the middle VWAP line; disable the upper and lower bands (they add noise)
PRECONDITION (confluence required): VWAP must line up with at least one other level (horizontal S/R, or a fib 0.5) â€” do NOT trade VWAP by itself
Treat the VWAP level as an AREA/zone, not a literal exact price (price often fakes through it before respecting it)
Entry option A: set an immediate limit order (buy/sell) at the confluence area
Entry option B: wait for a candlestick confirmation (bullish hammer for longs; long-wick sweep of equal highs or a fresh lower-low for shorts) and enter at the candle close
Long stop placement: below the VWAP
Short stop placement: just above the swing highs / swept highs
Targets: opposite S/R levels â€” resistance above for longs, support below for shorts, for favorable risk-to-reward
SELECTION: for shorts in strong bullish momentum, wait for a proper lower low to form before entering rather than entering the first retest
Anchor-period configuration: session (default), weekly, or monthly VWAP
Higher-timeframe anchored VWAP levels are more significant; can combine multiple VWAP anchors (e.g. session + monthly) for added confluence
Watching the VWAP get repeatedly tested and weakened until it breaks gives confidence it will hold as S/R on the subsequent retest
strategies.entry_summary: Use price vs the (middle-line) VWAP to set trend bias â€” above VWAP = only take longs, below VWAP = only take shorts. Identify a horizontal support/resistance level that the VWAP-as-S/R zone aligns with (optionally add a fib 0.5), requiring VWAP to be one factor of confluence, never used alone. When price retraces back into that confluence zone (treated as an area, not an exact number), either enter immediately with a limit order at the area OR wait for a candlestick confirmation (bullish hammer for longs; a swept series of equal highs with a long wick, or a fresh lower low / retest of the swing + fair value gap for shorts) and enter at the candle close.
strategies.exit_summary: Longs: stop below the VWAP; target resistance levels above. Shorts: stop just above the swing highs; target support levels lower. Aim for favorable risk-to-reward against the opposite S/R levels.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: price above VWAP; retest of broken-resistance-turned-support aligned with VWAP; enter immediately at the area or after a bullish hammer / next bullish candle close
variants.target_note: resistance levels above; stop below the VWAP

variants.target_note: support levels lower; stop just above the swept highs
variants.transcript_quote: the market swept through these highs with a long Wick here we can enter at the candle close setting our stops just above and targeting our support levels lower
variants.variant_label: Short â€” VWAP-as-resistance with sweep/lower-low confirmation

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: same S/R-retest entry, but reaction off the higher-TF anchored VWAP (e.g. price reverses at the monthly VWAP) treated as more significant; wait for candlestick pattern at the tap
variants.target_note: resistance/support levels beyond the confluence; stop beyond the anchored VWAP/swing
variants.timeframe_note: anchor period changed from session to weekly or monthly; can plot multiple VWAPs (session + monthly) together
